title: Cross-region fleet flexplan and utilization scenarios Q4 2026
body:
Purpose:
This working sheet lays out an actionable cross-region (NA / EU / APAC) GPU capacity flex plan for Q4 2026 with utilization scenarios, surge/decommission windows, and a prioritized rollout timeline. Intended audience: infra leads, SRE, release engineering, and finance for commit estimates.

Executive summary (one paragraph):
We project a base steady-state need of 3,600 A100-equivalent GPUs across NA/EU/APAC by 2026-12-31 for hosted+dedi combined, with a 20% buffer (pre-warm/burst) required to meet 99th-percentile latency during marketing-driven demand spikes. The plan introduces an adjustable flex pool (ephemeral instances + reservation rebalancing), a phased decommission window for older T4/L4 capacity, and region-specific autoscale triggers tied to latency SLOs instead of raw utilization. This sheet outlines three plausible utilization scenarios (conservative, expected, surge) and the recommended timeline for rolling out flex pools and decommissioning underutilized units.

Key assumptions:
- A100-equivalent = baseline performance unit. H100 = 1.8x A100, L4 = 0.22x A100 for cost/effectiveness calculations.
- Target SLO: p95 token latency <= 120 ms for generation endpoints in NA/EU; APAC target p95 <= 160 ms due to region infra constraints.
- Steady-state growth: 12% month-over-month request volume growth assumed through Q4.
- Workload mix: 58% short-chat (<= 256 tokens), 32% medium (256-1024), 10% long (1k-8k).
- Cache hit rate improvements from Optimize expected to reduce token compute by 8% by end of Q4.

Per-region nominal capacity targets (A100-equivalent units):
- NA: steady-state 1,800; buffer 360; target pool 2,160
- EU: steady-state 1,080; buffer 216; target pool 1,296
- APAC: steady-state 720; buffer 144; target pool 864
Total target pool = 4,320 (3,600 steady + 720 buffer)

Three scenarios (impact and actions):
1) Conservative (low growth / 8% monthly): utilization averaged 55-65%. Actions: postpone large reserved increases; enable spot-backed flex pools in NA only; schedule L4 decomm windows in EU for Q1 2027.
2) Expected (base assumptions above): utilization 65-80% with hourly p95 latency spikes. Actions: deploy cross-region flex pool (ephemeral H100 instances in NA and EU), increase pre-warm to 20% in NA, configure smart routing to offload best-effort background jobs to APAC off-hours.
3) Surge (marketing event / model launch): utilization 85-100% sustained for 6-36 hours. Actions: immediate fallback to compatible quantized variants, enable emergency regional burst quotas, trigger dedicated on-call escalation for provisioning, initiate auto-fallback to hosted-cache warm replicas.

Suggested rollout timeline (milestone-style):
- 2026-09-15 -> Pilot: NA flex pool using spot H100s + auto-drain policy. Measure cold-starts, KV warm-up.
- 2026-10-03 -> EU flex pilot (smaller scale; stronger pre-warm due to regulatory latency sensitivity).
- 2026-10-20 -> GA flex pool controls in Console: per-customer burst quotas, cost caps, telemetry hooks.
- 2026-11-05 -> Start phased decommission of T4/L4 in NA (target 15% of older units) with 2-week safety hold.
- 2026-11-22 -> Full cross-region routing policy live (latency-first, cost-fallback).
- 2026-12-10 -> Resilience drill: simulated surge + failover to APAC; 4-hour test window.

Rolling decommission strategy (practical notes):
- Rule: any device with sustained <30% CPU/GPU utilization for 90 days flagged for review.
- Safety: keep 10% of old-generation capacity as warm fallback for model-compatibility regressions.
- Billing: align decommission events with reservation renewal windows to avoid premature termination charges.

Capacity delta table (quarterly snapshots simplified, A100-equivalent):
Q3-2026 actual: NA 1,540 | EU 980 | APAC 620 (total 3,140)
Q4-2026 base target: NA 1,800 | EU 1,080 | APAC 720 (total 3,600)
Q4-2026 buffer (20%): NA +360 | EU +216 | APAC +144 (total +720)
Q1-2027 conservative: total 3,840 (small reserved increases)
Q1-2027 surge plan: on-demand ephemeral capacity up to +30% of total (1,296 A100-equivalent)

Operational playbook highlights (runbooks to create):
- Pre-warm sizing guide (by model class and rate-of-requests-per-second).
- Cold-start mitigation checklist (KV pre-load, prompt cache, quantized fallback config).
- Cost-control guardrails (per-team budget alarms, burst-quotas with emergency escalation).
- Post-surge reconciliation (snapshot utilization, analyze cache efficacy, recommend reservation commits).

Telemetry and KPIs to track in Console:
- Region-level p95/p99 latency by endpoint and model variant (daily slice).
- GPU slot occupancy (1m/5m/1h) per zone.
- Cold-start rate (% of requests hitting empty KV).
- Cache hit rate (global + per-customer).
- Cost per effective A100-hour (factoring quantization and H100 multipliers).

Risk register (top 5):
- Supply constraints for H100 in APAC (mitigation: earlier reservations + partner inventory).
- Overcommit causing elevated tail latency (mitigation: conservative autoscale thresholds, circuit-breaker routing).
- Billing surprise from spot preemptions during a surge (mitigation: mixed pool + reserved baseline).
- Model regressions after moving to quantized variants (mitigation: canary rollouts + automatic rollback).
- Regulatory constraints preventing cross-border KV caching (mitigation: region-local caches + limited routing).

Open decisions / ask list (for leadership):
- Approve $6.2M upper-bound discretionary cap for Q4 burst experiments (will be gated by telemetry).
- Decision on L4 decommission timeline (accelerate vs defer to H1-2027).
- Confirm APAC H100 reservation size (propose 120 H100-equivalents to avoid supply volatility).

Appendix: quick math examples
- Effective capacity if we add 100 H100s in NA: 100 * 1.8 = 180 A100-eq. Adds ~5% to NA steady-state.
- If cache improves by 8% global, token compute reduces roughly 8% -> effective capacity freed = 3,600 * 0.08 = 288 A100-eq.

Notes / scratch area (raw):
- Test notes from pilot 2026-08: spot H100 pre-warm 90s median cold-start after warmup; KV preload reduced cold-start to ~30s.
- Chat with procurement 2026-07-30: next available H100 bulk window estimated Nov 2026.
- Pending: run cost-sim using real request traces (PR to infra-sim repo).

Next steps (this team):
1) Finalize pilot test plan with SRE by 2026-09-20.
2) Create Console controls PR (owner: Priya) by 2026-09-28.
3) Finance to confirm discretionary cap decision by 2026-09-30.

This document is a working artifact — expect iterations. Capture feedback inline or in JIRA-INFRA-8812.
